title: A thermodynamic correction layer for machine learning interatomic potentials
title_zh: 用于机器学习原子间势的热力学校正层
summary: 机器学习原子间势能够在大长度和时间尺度上以接近从头开始的精度进行原子模拟。基础模型将这种能力扩展到整个元素周期表，但继承了用于生成训练数据的电子结构方法的热力学描述。因此，相对相位稳定性的小误差可能会导致转变温度的大误差。我们引入了附加热力学校正层，该层可将相自由能移向评估参考，而无需重新训练或修改基础电势。一阶热力学结构将所需的相自由能位移直接转换为构型能量目标，该目标使用线性原子团簇展开进行拟合，并根据测量的自由能迭代细化。
abstract: arXiv:2610.34551v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials enable atomistic simulations with near ab initio accuracy over large length and time scales. Foundation models extend this capability across the periodic table but inherit the thermodynamic description of the electronic structure methods used to generate their training data. Small errors in relative phase stability can therefore produce large errors in transformation temperatures. We introduce an additive thermodynamic correction layer that shifts phase free energies towards an assessed reference without retraining or modifying the base potential. A first order thermodynamic construction converts the required phase free energy shifts directly into configuration energy targets, which are fitted using a linear atomic cluster expansion and refined iteratively from measured free energies. We apply the method to melting and solid to solid transformations across elements with different crystal structures using a foundation GRACE model. After the correction, all transformation temperatures lie within the prescribed tolerance of the assessed values, including Ca, Ti, and Zr, where a solid to solid transition and melting are corrected together. Static energy curves, bulk moduli, and liquid structure remain close to those of the base model. Vacancy formation energies, thermal expansion, and liquid density depend on the corrected phase balance and change where the correction is large. The method requires neither retraining, differentiable dynamics, nor access to the parameters of the base potential. It provides a modular route for combining transferable atomistic models with assessed phase thermodynamics.

title: CrystalREPA: Transferring Physical Priors from Universal MLIPs to Crystal Generative Models
title_zh: CrystalREPA：将物理先验从通用 MLIP 转移到 Crystal 生成模型
summary: 晶体生成模型主要学习稳定晶体的外观，很少明确监督它们稳定的原因。我们通过能量探测揭示了最先进的晶体生成模型与预训练的通用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）之间存在巨大的表征差距，并表明这种差距可以通过简单的训练时间对齐来弥补。
abstract: arXiv:2605.08960v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Crystal generative models mainly learn what stable crystals look like, with little explicit supervision for what makes them stable. We reveal a substantial representation gap between state-of-the-art crystal generative models and pretrained universal machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) via energy probing, and show this gap can be closed by a simple training-time alignment. We propose Crystal REPresentation Alignment (CrystalREPA), a plug-and-play framework that aligns the atom-wise hidden states of generative encoders with frozen MLIP representations through an element-aware contrastive objective, transferring stability-aware atomistic priors with marginal training overhead and no additional inference cost. Across three generative frameworks, ten MLIP teachers, and two benchmark datasets, CrystalREPA consistently improves the thermodynamic stability, structural validity, and structural fidelity of generated crystals. Equally important, we find that an MLIP's transfer effectiveness is poorly predicted by its accuracy on standard leaderboards (e.g., Matbench Discovery) but strongly predicted by the distinguishability of its atom-wise representation space, yielding a practical, accuracy-independent criterion for selecting MLIP teachers for generative transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/Chengqian-Zhang/CrystalREPA.

title: Designing Strongly Correlated Quantum Phases of Matter with Foundation Neural-Network Quantum States
title_zh: 利用基础神经网络量子态设计强相关的物质量子相
summary: 材料设计是一个逆问题：找到基态表现出所需特性的微观哈密顿量的耦合。对于强相关的量子系统，这在很大程度上仍然遥不可及，因为每个候选哈密顿量都需要自己昂贵的模拟。在这里，我们展示了基础神经网络量子态（对整个哈密顿量家族的基态进行编码的单波函数）使这种搜索变得高效。由于哈密顿耦合作为神经网络输入，因此任何基态属性都可以直接在耦合空间中通过梯度下降进行优化。我们使用这种方法在维度递增的耦合空间中搜索二维自旋模型中的非磁性相。
abstract: arXiv:2609.40209v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Materials design is an inverse problem: finding the couplings of a microscopic Hamiltonian whose ground state exhibits a desired property. For strongly correlated quantum systems, this remains largely out of reach, as each candidate Hamiltonian requires its own costly simulation. Here we show that Foundation Neural-Network Quantum States, single wave functions that encode the ground states of an entire family of Hamiltonians, make this search efficient. Because the Hamiltonian couplings enter as neural-network inputs, any ground-state property can be optimized by gradient descent directly in coupling space. We use this approach to search for nonmagnetic phases in two-dimensional spin models in coupling spaces of increasing dimensionality. Specifically, we focus on quantum spin liquids, exotic phases of matter in which quantum fluctuations prevent magnetic order at zero temperature. In the largest search space considered, spanned by eight superexchange couplings and containing many paradigmatic frustrated spin systems, the optimization converges to the J₁-J₂-δ Heisenberg model when starting from a magnetic phase. We show that the ground state at the optimum set of couplings has neither magnetic nor valence-bond order in the thermodynamic limit, leading to a new quantum spin-liquid candidate. The approach is completely general and can be extended to other models and physical properties to optimize, demonstrating that Neural-Network Quantum States are tools not only for simulating quantum matter but also for designing it.

title: Tangent-plane evidential uncertainty in active learning for magnetic interatomic potentials
title_zh: 磁原子间势主动学习中的切面证据不确定性
summary: 作者：杨程、洪宇宇和洪军项 磁原子间势需要考虑耦合的晶格和自旋自由度，但构建可靠的训练集仍然昂贵，因为非共线第一原理标签很昂贵。主动学习可以减轻这种成本，前提是不确定性估计是物理的……[物理。 Rev. Materials 10, 103807] 2026 年 10 月 27 日星期二发布

title: Revealing the proton slingshot mechanism in solid acid electrolytes through machine learning molecular dynamics
title_zh: 通过机器学习分子动力学揭示固体酸电解质中的质子弹弓机制
summary: 在固体酸性电解质 CsH2PO4 和 CsHSO4 中，快速质子传导的起源长期以来一直存在争议，归因于局部质子跳跃或聚阴离子旋转。然而，聚阴离子旋转的确切作用及其与质子跳跃的相互作用仍未解决。由等变神经网络力场驱动的纳秒级分子动力学模拟揭示了一种微妙的质子弹弓机制：质子首先由旋转的聚阴离子携带，随后进行 O-H 键重新取向，并且组合运动能够实现长程跳跃。该机制挑战了传统的旋转桨轮模型，揭示了长程传输是由仅有限的聚阴离子旋转辅助的显着的O-H键重新取向引起的。
abstract: arXiv:2503.15389v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In solid acid electrolytes CsH₂PO₄ and CsHSO₄, the origin of fast proton conduction has long been debated, attributed either to local proton hopping or to polyanion rotation. However, the precise role of polyanion rotation and its interplay with proton hopping remained unresolved. Nanosecond-scale molecular dynamics simulations, driven by equivariant neural network force fields, reveal a nuanced proton slingshot mechanism: protons are first carried by rotating polyanions, followed by O-H bond reorientation, and the combined motion enables long-range jumps. This mechanism challenges the conventional revolving paddlewheel model, revealing long-range transport arises from significant O-H bond reorientation assisted by only limited polyanion rotation. Despite their structural similarity, CsH₂PO₄ and CsHSO₄ exhibit qualitatively different transport behavior, governed by their distinct proton concentrations. In CsH₂PO₄, two rotation rates with different activation energies emerge, while CsHSO₄ displays a single-rate process with faster productive polyanion dynamics. The higher proton concentration in CsH₂PO₄ frustrates PO₄ rotation, resulting in slower dynamics than for SO₄ in CsHSO₄. In CsH₂PO₄, we further identify a unique correlation between oxygen sharing and proton transport, arising from the extra proton per polyanion. Together, our findings establish a unified framework linking polyanion rotation, proton coordination, and long-range transport, and suggest that tuning proton concentration could accelerate rotation and enhance conductivity.

title: Parity-equivariant prediction of conformer-resolved electronic circular dichroism spectra accelerates absolute configuration assignment
title_zh: 构象异构体分辨电子圆二色光谱的奇偶等变预测加速了绝对构型分配
summary: 电子圆二色性 (ECD) 是分配手性分子绝对构型的关键实验探针，但解释测量的光谱通常需要昂贵的时间相关密度泛函理论 (TDDFT) 计算。现有的几种用于 ECD 预测的机器学习方法速度更快，但其准确性仍然远远低于实验应用所需的水平。在这里，我们介绍 PhysECD，这是一种奇偶校验 E(3) 等变框架，它从其基础量子化学量构建光谱，通过构建确保正确的手性光学对称性。
abstract: arXiv:2608.21892v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Electronic circular dichroism (ECD) is a key experimental probe for assigning the absolute configuration of chiral molecules, but interpreting measured spectra often requires costly time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT) calculations. The few existing machine learning methods for ECD prediction are faster, but their accuracy still falls well short of that required for experimental applications. Here we introduce PhysECD, a parity-aware E(3)-equivariant framework that builds the spectrum from its underlying quantum-chemical quantities, ensuring correct chiroptical symmetry by construction. To improve generalization and support experimental applications, we construct SCECD, a conformer-resolved dataset of 578,104 computed spectra spanning diverse natural products with one to five stereocentres. PhysECD predicts ECD spectra from conformer geometries in milliseconds, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy on the CMCDS benchmark and SCECD. Validation against 77 experimental spectra further demonstrates that PhysECD can serve as a fast alternative to TDDFT for assigning the absolute configuration of complex chiral molecules.

title: Accelerating SO(2)-Equivariant Materials Models through Low-Precision Emulation
title_zh: 通过低精度仿真加速 SO(2) 等效材料模型
summary: 旋转等变架构提高了基于图神经网络 (GNN) 的机器学习 (ML) 通用材料模型的物理保真度。然而，它们的可扩展性受到训练和推理过程中使用重要的高精度张量运算的限制。采用矩阵乘法单元 (MMU) 的精度降低格式（例如，用 FP8 代替 FP32）可大幅提高吞吐量，在 NVIDIA Hopper (Blackwell) GPU 上高达 30 倍 (60 倍)，但可能会导致精度大幅下降。
abstract: arXiv:2610.35164v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rotationally equivariant architectures improve the physical fidelity of machine-learned (ML) universal materials models based on graph neural networks (GNNs). However, their scalability is limited by the use of non-trivial, high-precision tensor operations during both training and inference. Adopting the reduced-precision formats of matrix multiplication units (MMUs), e.g., FP8 instead of FP32, provides massive increases in throughput, up to 30x (60x) on NVIDIA Hopper (Blackwell) GPUs, but may lead to drastic loss of accuracy. Here, we introduce tailored 'emulated' low-precision operations under the integer Ozaki scheme to accelerate the 'SO(2)-equivariant' processing layers of GNNs, which dominate the runtime of (1) many state-of-the-art ML interatomic potentials (MLIPs) and (2) most universal ML Hamiltonian (MLH) models. Our framework, FlashSO(2), outperforms TF32, the most accurate native low-precision MMU format, in throughput, accuracy, and memory footprint at once. At the SO(2) layer level, it reaches 40x (7x) the throughput of MALOQ's (UMA's) reference implementation, an MLH (MLIP) model, sustaining up to 236 (232) effective Tflop/s on an NVIDIA GH200, 3.5x the FP32 peak. At the model level, FlashSO(2) helps train MALOQ 3.9x faster than its pure-FP32 version while reducing peak memory by 58% at no loss in accuracy. In molecular dynamics simulations with UMA, the speedup factor is 3.3x, and the peak memory is reduced by 51%. FlashSO(2) thus pushes the speed-accuracy Pareto frontier of equivariant materials models beyond the native low-precision formats and substantially lowers the resources required to exploit their scaling laws.

title: Autonomous atomistic-continuum coupling through uncertainty-aware active learning
title_zh: 通过不确定性感知主动学习实现自主原子连续耦合
summary: 我们开发了一种不确定性感知代理建模方法，用于将原子动力学蒙特卡罗（KMC）表面化学求解器与跨不同物理长度和时间尺度的连续多物种流体动力学求解器耦合。替代模型预测六种物质的边界质量通量及其不确定性，连续介质求解器会对其进行监控，以便在需要新的训练数据时自动触发额外的 KMC 模拟。这可以实现高效的多尺度耦合并保持用户指定的精度水平。我们演示了反应性卤化物-钙钛矿气相沉积方法，该方法涉及多物质蒸气射流撞击反应性基材。
abstract: arXiv:2610.33272v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop an uncertainty-aware surrogate modeling approach for coupling an atomistic kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) surface-chemistry solver with a continuum multi-species fluid dynamics solver across disparate physical length and time scales. The surrogate model predicts boundary mass fluxes for six species and their uncertainties, which the continuum solver monitors to automatically trigger additional KMC simulations when new training data are needed. This enables efficient multiscale coupling and maintains a user-specified level of accuracy. We demonstrate the approach for reactive halide-perovskite vapor deposition, which involves a multi-species vapor jet impinging on a reactive substrate. The KMC solver uses a DFT-calibrated energetics model that we construct as part of this work and provides net deposition and desorption rates for six species. With a conservative uncertainty threshold, the surrogate-coupled approach reproduces cumulative mass fluxes of the directly coupled approach with errors typically within 10-20%, while capturing the non-monotonic dependence of net deposition on species partial pressure. Importantly, the results show that detailed crystal structure need not be explicitly represented to predict quantities exchanged between atomistic and continuum solvers; species-resolved mass fluxes provide a sufficiently low-dimensional representation of the atomistic response. For this accuracy target, the autonomous online-learning approach reduces the number of required atomistic simulations by two to three orders of magnitude relative to direct multiscale coupling.

title: Single-Cycle Battery Remaining Useful Life Prediction with Compressed Continuous Wavelet Features and Deep Neural Networks
title_zh: 利用压缩连续小波特征和深度神经网络进行单循环电池剩余使用寿命预测
summary: 锂离子电池广泛应用于工业应用，但其性能会随着时间的推移而逐渐下降，因此准确的寿命预测对于安全性和可靠性非常重要。然而，可靠的寿命评估通常需要大量的降解测试，这既昂贵又耗时。为了减轻这种负担，最近的数据驱动方法试图仅从最初的几个周期来预测电池的寿命周期。然而，从如此有限的早期周期数据中识别可靠的降解模式仍然具有挑战性，因为早期老化动态通常是微妙的和非线性的。为了解决这个问题，我们采用连续小波变换将周期电压、电流和容量信号转换为时频表示，从而实现退化行为的多分辨率表征。
abstract: arXiv:2610.34159v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lithium-ion batteries are widely used in industrial applications, but their performance gradually degrades over time, making accurate lifetime prediction important for safety and reliability. However, reliable lifetime assessment generally requires extensive degradation testing, which is both costly and time-consuming. To reduce this burden, recent data-driven approaches have sought to predict the end-of-life cycle of batteries from only the initial few cycles. Nevertheless, identifying reliable degradation patterns from such limited early-cycle data remains challenging because early aging dynamics are often subtle and nonlinear. To address this issue, we adopt the continuous wavelet transform to convert cycle-wise voltage, current, and capacity signals into time-frequency representations, enabling multi-resolution characterization of degradation behavior. Building on this representation, we apply scale compression to reduce redundancy while preserving structural information in the scalograms. We evaluate the proposed framework on eight benchmark datasets derived from seven public battery datasets covering diverse electrode chemistries, cell form factors, and cycling protocols. Experimental results show that the proposed framework consistently outperforms prior approaches in single-cycle remaining useful life prediction and remains robust as the number of input cycles increases from 1 to 100. In addition, redundancy-fidelity analysis characterizes the trade-off introduced by scale compression, and gradient-based visual explanations indicate that the model focuses on localized time-frequency regions associated with structured signal transitions during charge-discharge operation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and interpretability of the proposed framework for early-cycle battery remaining useful life prediction.

title: Physics-Informed Graph-Based Safe RL with Constraint-Specific Critics for Community Battery Coordination in Distribution Network
title_zh: 基于物理知识图的安全强化学习，具有特定于约束的批评，用于配电网络中的社区电池协调
summary: 分布式能源 (DER) 的高渗透率和快速变化的电动汽车 (EV) 充电加剧了配电网络 (DN) 中的电压和线路限制违规行为，使安全、低成本运营变得越来越具有挑战性。本文提出了一种基于物理的安全深度强化学习（DRL）框架，用于协调社区电池储能系统，以减轻约束违规，同时最大限度地降低运营成本。为了表示非局域时空相互作用，我们开发了一种双层物理信息图形表示，其中线路阻抗和容量塑造空间信息传播，而功率平衡、电压分布和流量重建损耗将潜在状态规范化，以实现与控制相关的物理一致性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.33654v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High penetrations of distributed energy resources (DERs) and fast-varying electric vehicle (EV) charging intensify voltage and line-limit violations in distribution networks (DNs), making safe, low-cost operation increasingly challenging. This paper proposes a physics-informed safe deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for coordinating community battery energy storage systems to mitigate constraint violations while minimizing operating cost. To represent nonlocal spatiotemporal interactions, we develop a dual-level physics-informed graph representation in which line impedance and capacity shape spatial information propagation, while power-balance, voltage-profile, and flow-reconstruction losses regularize the latent state toward control-relevant physical consistency. Building on this representation, we develop Lagrangian Dedicated-Critic PPO (LDCPPO), which implements constraint-specific value decomposition: independent reward and cost critics preserve heterogeneous voltage- and line-loading-related learning signals and combine their advantages only during the Lagrangian policy update. Case studies on DNs with high rooftop photovoltaic penetration and EV charging demonstrate that the proposed method reduces the key voltage-violation degree by up to 80.5% compared with the tested baselines, while also achieving the lowest voltage-violation count and line-overload degree with competitive operating cost.

title: Retention-constrained fine-tuning of a pre-trained aluminium MACE potential for non-equilibrium defect dynamics and plasticity
title_zh: 针对非平衡缺陷动力学和塑性的预训练铝 MACE 电位的保留约束微调
summary: 针对非平衡缺陷动力学和塑性调整预先训练的机器学习原子间势需要在不降低近平衡弹性和振动响应的情况下提高缺陷精度。在这里，我们通过集成条件读数不确定性、迭代全参数更新和协议兼容的相对能量锚定来实现铝 MACE 势 QP17 的平衡。超过 144 个线性读出权重的灵敏度指导采集，并具有批内协方差更新和不断发展的神经表示。
abstract: arXiv:2610.35653v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Adapting a pre-trained machine-learning interatomic potential for non-equilibrium defect dynamics and plasticity requires improving defect accuracy without degrading the near-equilibrium elastic and vibrational response. Here we achieve this balance for the aluminium MACE potential QP17 by integrating conditional readout uncertainty, iterative full-parameter updates and protocol-compatible relative-energy anchoring. Sensitivities over 144 linear readout weights guide acquisition, with within-batch covariance updates and evolving neural representations. After four active-learning rounds (32 acquired configurations and 400 gradient updates), force-uncertainty acquisition reduces mean development force error from 22.43 to 21.52 meV/Angstrom, outperforming random sampling (22.70), geometry-diversity selection (22.46) and uniform training across all 104 candidate labels (22.71) under the same update budget. All three force-uncertainty runs satisfy bulk-mechanical retention criteria: historical relative-energy error decreases from 0.375 to 0.207 meV/atom, while harmonic phonon root-mean-square drift remains below 0.05 THz. Matched objective ablations reveal that relative-energy anchoring suppresses harmonic drift. Out-of-sample evaluations across planar faults, twin boundaries and grain boundaries demonstrate transferable gains in defect energies and deviatoric stresses, even though virial stresses are never fitted. A closed-loop molecular dynamics and density functional theory (MD-DFT) pilot confirms that automated acceptance gating intercepts updates that violate historical elastic-group energy or vibrational tolerances. Together, these components establish a retention-constrained fine-tuning protocol for improving plastic-deformation observables while preserving the tested bulk mechanical response.

title: Phase field dislocation dynamics prediction of stacking fault widths in Cu-Al Alloys using generalised stacking fault energy from DFT and interatomic potentials
title_zh: 使用 DFT 和原子间势的广义堆垛层错能量预测铜铝合金堆垛层错宽度的相场位错动力学
summary: 本征堆垛层错的平衡宽度是影响关键变形现象的重要材料参数。在这里，我们对不同 Al 含量的铜铝合金使用 MD（具有经典嵌入原子势 (ZW) 和机器学习的高斯近似势 (GAP)）和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 生成的 γ 表面进行比较评估，并将它们作为能量项纳入 PFDD 模拟中以获得平衡 SFW。
abstract: arXiv:2610.34420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The equilibrium width of intrinsic stacking faults is an important material parameter affecting key deformation phenomena. Here, we perform a comparative assessment of γ-surfaces generated using MD -- with a classical embedded-atom potential (ZW) and a machine-learned Gaussian Approximation Potential (GAP) -- and density functional theory (DFT), for Cu-Al alloys of varying Al content, and incorporate them as an energy term in PFDD simulations to obtain the equilibrium SFW. All three methods reproduce the lattice parameter and elastic moduli of Cu and Cu-Al alloys in reasonable agreement with each other and with experimental measurements from literature, but the MD-derived γ-surfaces, for both ZW and GAP, deviate substantially from DFT at the seven characteristic points, with the largest discrepancies at T and T₁. When incorporated into PFDD, the DFT-derived γ-surfaces successfully predict an equilibrium SFW that increases with Al content and agrees well with standalone MD measurements and experimental values for pure Cu, whereas the MD-derived γ-surfaces do not yield an accurate SFW within PFDD, as the altered generalized stacking fault energy landscape causes the dissociating partials to become pinned soon after separation. These results show that DFT-derived γ-surfaces remain the more reliable route to alloy SFW prediction, and interatomic potentials must capture the shear path accurately to enable robust, efficient MD-PFDD modelling of stacking faults in alloys.

title: Precursor Ratio-Controlled Chloride Vacancies in Lead-Free KCuCl3-x Memristors for Forming-Free Gradual Resistive Switching and Neuromorphic Learning
title_zh: 无铅 KCuCl3-x 忆阻器中前驱体比例控制的氯空位，用于无成型渐进电阻开关和神经形态学习
summary: 忆阻材料的缺陷工程为调节神经形态计算所需的离子传输和模拟电阻开关提供了强大的策略。在这里，我们报告了无铅全无机 KCuCl3-x 薄膜中氯空位（VCl）工程的湿化学合成路线，并建立了缺陷浓度、电子结构、输运动力学和神经形态性能之间的直接相关性。受控的前驱体比率变化可系统地调节 KCuCl3-x 薄膜中的 VCl 浓度，从而驱动末端氯化物位点优先形成空位、带隙变窄并增强电子无序。
abstract: arXiv:2610.35436v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Defect engineering of memristive materials offers a powerful strategy for regulating ionic transport and analog resistive switching required for neuromorphic computing. Here, we report a wet chemical synthesis route for chloride-vacancy (VCl) engineering in lead-free all-inorganic KCuCl3-x thin films and establish a direct correlation between defect concentration, electronic structure, transport dynamics, and neuromorphic performance. Controlled precursor-ratio variation systematically tunes the VCl concentration in KCuCl3-x thin films, driving preferential vacancy formation at the terminal chloride sites, band-gap narrowing, and enhanced electronic disorder. W/KCuCl3-x/FTO memristors exhibit stable bipolar VCM-type resistive switching, with increasing VCl concentration promoting forming-free operation. An optimal VCl concentration (~ 1.3*10²¹ cm⁻³) provides a balance between ionic mobility and defect controllability, resulting in highly linear potentiation/depression characteristics and superior pulse endurance (>104 cycles). When the experimentally measured conductance characteristics of the optimized memristor are implemented as synaptic weights in artificial neural network simulations, recognition accuracies of 98.96% and 91.82% are achieved on the MNIST and Fashion-MNIST datasets, respectively. These findings establish precursor ratio-controlled VCl engineering as an effective strategy for simultaneously optimizing ionic transport, analog switching, and neuromorphic learning in lead-free halide perovskite memristors, providing a general materials design principle for energy-efficient neuromorphic electronics.

title: High-efficiency solid-state electrochemical thermal switching through phonon engineering of 2D materials
title_zh: 通过二维材料的声子工程实现高效固态电化学热开关
summary: 具有大热对比度的可逆固态热开关仍然很少见，但对于先进的热管理至关重要。使用通用机器学习原子间势 (uMLIP) 和密度泛函理论 (DFT)，我们筛选了 57 种过渡金属二硫属化物 (TMDC)，跨越具有 Li 和 Mg 嵌入的 1T 和 2H 相。在这些候选材料中，LiₐZrS2 结合了出色的热导率转换和低热容。锂化成Li0.125ZrS2将横截面热导率从约3.7降低至0.05Wm-1K-1。开关行为超过了之前报道的固态电化学热开关。
abstract: arXiv:2610.35547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reversible solid-state thermal switches with large thermal contrasts remain rare, yet are essential for advanced thermal management. Using universal machine-learned interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) and density functional theory (DFT), we screen 57 transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs), spanning the 1T and 2H phases with Li and Mg intercalation. Among the candidates, LiₐZrS₂ combines exceptional thermal conductivity switching with low heat capacity. Lithiation to Li₀.₁₂₅ZrS₂ reduces the cross-plane thermal conductivity from approximately 3.7 to 0.05 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹. The switching behaviour exceeds that of previously reported solid-state electrochemical thermal switches. Device-level modelling further demonstrates the potential for waste-heat recovery, with a pulsed system capturing 86% of the energy recovered by an ideal switch. We attribute the switching behaviour to substantial softening of the Zr--Zr framework, with the mean force constant decreasing from approximately 4.2 to 1.2 eV mathrmmathringA⁻², alongside enhanced scattering of heat-carrying acoustic phonons. These findings establish electrochemical intercalation as a promising route to engineering thermal transport in layered materials.

title: A Stable, High-Order Time-Stepping Scheme for the Drift-Diffusion Model in Modern Solar Cell Simulation
title_zh: 现代太阳能电池模拟中漂移扩散模型的稳定、高阶时间步进方案
summary: 本文提出了一种用于先进太阳能电池的一维瞬态漂移扩散模拟器，将结构保持的有限体积空间离散与 Scharfetter-Gummel 型通量和高阶 L 稳定隐式龙格库塔 (Radau IIA) 时间积分器集成在一起。该方案确保局部电荷守恒，处理尖锐的材料界面，实现二阶空间和五阶时间收敛，并表现出优异的计算效率和数值稳定性。其准确性根据 p-n 结中的经典耗尽近似进行了验证，并根据通用协议下的有机光伏器件的四个独立软件实现进行了验证。
abstract: arXiv:2603.09063v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper presents a one-dimensional transient drift-diffusion simulator for advanced solar cells, integrating a structure-preserving finite-volume spatial discretization with Scharfetter-Gummel-type fluxes and a high-order, L-stable implicit Runge-Kutta (Radau IIA) temporal integrator. The scheme ensures local charge conservation, handles sharp material interfaces, achieves second-order spatial and fifth-order temporal convergence, and exhibits excellent computational efficiency and numerical stability. Its accuracy is verified against the classical depletion approximation in p-n junction and validated against four independent software implementations for an organic photovoltaic device under a common protocol. The framework's extensibility is demonstrated by incorporating exciton kinetics in organic solar cells, capturing multi-timescale dynamics, and by modeling mobile ions in perovskite solar cells, reproducing characteristic J-V hysteresis without empirical parameters. This work provides a robust, high-order numerical foundation for simulating coupled charge, exciton, and ion transport in next-generation photovoltaic devices.

title: MatOS: An Agent Operating System for Materials Research
title_zh: MatOS ：一种用于材料研究的代理操作系统
summary: 材料研究依赖于分散且不断增长的数据、知识和模拟工具，一项研究通常跨越文献分析、计算和实验等多天的工作流程。大型语言模型代理现在可以检索材料数据，操作模拟代码，并与自主实验室关闭设计-合成-表征循环。然而，用新功能扩展这些代理、让长时间运行的任务保持在正轨上并让它们从过去的任务和用户反馈中学习仍然很困难。在这里，我们介绍 MatOS，一个用于材料研究的代理操作系统，具有三个核心组件：（1）分层科学资产图，将数据、知识、工具、技能、角色和工作流程组织为可重用资产；
abstract: arXiv:2610.34203v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Materials research relies on scattered and growing data, knowledge, and simulation tools, and a single study often spans multi-day workflows across literature analysis, computation, and experiment. Large language model agents can now retrieve materials data, operate simulation codes, and close design-synthesis-characterization loops with autonomous laboratories. However, extending these agents with new capabilities, keeping long-running tasks on track, and letting them learn from past tasks and user feedback remain difficult. Here we present MatOS, an agent operating system for materials research with three core components: (1) a layered scientific asset graph that organizes data, knowledge, tools, skills, roles, and workflows as reusable assets; (2) a stateful adaptive workflow that runs tasks as explicit execution graphs with scientific checks, so that they can be resumed and traced; and (3) evidence-driven asset evolution, which revises these assets from execution records and user feedback. On ResearchClawBench, MatOS improves on the previously best-performing agent by 11.15% with the same base model and extends the cost-score Pareto frontier. With a common base model, it outperforms Codex CLI and Claude Code, exceeding Codex CLI by 2.13% on MatTools and 4.17% on SciAgentGym. In eight research cases, MatOS narrowed more than 30 million candidate structures to 97 solid-electrolyte candidates, identified 89 halide variants with higher computed conductivity than their parent structures, linked the force errors of 11 pretrained interatomic potentials to local atomic environments, and supported two new methods that reduce errors by 3.1% and 13.6% relative to their baselines. These results show that organizing research capabilities as reusable, evolving assets enables agents to carry out long, multistage materials studies. Code is available at https://github.com/DingyangLyu/MatOS.
